sv.title: Chockstraffet för ”Sven”: Tolv års fängelse
sv.summary: Tolv års fängelse blir det nya gängstraffet för en kille som kallades Sven innan han gick i polisens fälla. Han döms bara för hantering av tre vapen – brott som tidigare gett två-tre års fängelse. Så motiveras det extremt hårda straffet.

en.title: Harsh sentence for "Sven": Twelve years in prison
en.summary: Twelve years in prison is the new gang sentence for a man known as Sven before he walked into a police trap. He was convicted only for handling three weapons – offences that previously led to two to three years in prison. This is how the extremely harsh sentence is justified.
